evals.prompt: 附件 single-manifest.json 是一份 schema v1 manifest。請先用 list_endnote_styles 確認 IEEE 樣式確實安裝，再用 search_endnote_library 與 precheck_endnote_manifest 對我的 EndNote library 檢查 manifest 內每一個 rec_number 與 DOI，且 DOI 必須能由 doi.org 解析（manifest 內的 library.path 是佔位路徑，請改成我實際的 .enl 路徑）。接著建立一份繁體中文的研究草稿 DOCX，段落中放入 manifest 的 {{CITE:thomsen2023}} 標記，然後靜默 render 成新的輸出檔並執行 manifest-aware validate。交付實際的 DOCX 與 validate JSON，不可只描述步驟，也不可自行打字產生假引用。
evals.expected_output: A real Traditional Chinese DOCX in which the marker has become one genuine ADDIN EN.CITE field carrying a traveling library payload, plus one ADDIN EN.REFLIST bibliography, the cited pages 45-46 rendered by EndNote itself, and a passing validation report.
expectations: Calls list_endnote_styles and precheck_endnote_manifest before rendering, and replaces the placeholder library path instead of rendering against it.
Blocks before Word opens unless the target DOI matches the bare library DOI and resolves through doi.org.
Keeps Word hidden and does not surface an EndNote window started by the bridge.
Produces a real output DOCX rather than a plan or an explanation that a file is missing.
Creates exactly one ADDIN EN.CITE field and exactly one ADDIN EN.REFLIST field; no citation text is typed by hand.
Lets EndNote produce the cited pages from the @45-46 temporary citation instead of appending the page range as literal text.
Runs manifest-aware validation and reports zero unresolved {{CITE: markers, zero residual temporary citations, and zero errors.

evals.prompt: Use the attached single-manifest.json to produce an English methods-section draft DOCX with a narrative sentence in which the cited author is the grammatical subject. Change that citation to display=author-year so EndNote produces Author et al. [x], then render and validate it. Replace the placeholder library.path with my real .enl library first, confirm IEEE with list_endnote_styles, and confirm every rec_number and DOI with precheck_endnote_manifest. Return the actual DOCX and validation JSON. Do not hand-write the author name, citation number, DOI link, or reference list.
evals.expected_output: A real English DOCX with one CWYW-produced ADDIN EN.CITE field displayed through ENAuthorYearFormat, one ADDIN EN.REFLIST bibliography visibly containing doi: https://doi.org/<DOI>, an EN.Layout document variable naming IEEE, and a passing validation report.
expectations: Verifies the style and the rec_number before opening Word.
Places the marker where the full narrative author phrase belongs and sets display to author-year, avoiding a duplicated typed author name.
Validates the visible canonical DOI link and rejects a duplicated resolver prefix.
Delivers a real DOCX file plus the validation JSON.
The bibliography is an ADDIN EN.REFLIST field with non-empty result text, not typed paragraphs.
The EN.Layout document variable records the style from the manifest.
Validation reports native_citation_fields equal to the manifest citation count.

evals.prompt: 附件 live-manifest.json 內含一個合併引用（merged，兩筆 targets）。請以我的 EndNote library 取代佔位的 library.path，先 precheck，再建立一份放入 {{CITE:merged}} 標記的 DOCX，render 之後驗證：合併引用必須是「一個」EN.CITE 欄位，而不是兩個；若 EndNote 把 traveling library 移到巢狀的 ADDIN EN.CITE.DATA 欄位，計數規則必須扣掉巢狀欄位。請回報 validate JSON 內的 counts 區塊並說明為什麼 native_citation_fields 是 1。
evals.expected_output: A real DOCX whose merged citation is a single ADDIN EN.CITE field, a validation report whose counts show native_citation_fields excluding any nested ADDIN EN.CITE.DATA field, and both record numbers present in the traveling library payload.
expectations: Emits one temporary citation of the form {Author, Year #N; Author, Year #M} rather than two adjacent citations.
Reports native_citation_fields computed as EN.CITE count minus EN.CITE.DATA count.
Both rec_numbers appear as <rec-number>N</rec-number> in the citation payload, including when the payload lives in a nested EN.CITE.DATA field.
The EN.Libraries document variable lists both record ids.
Does not claim success without running validation.

evals.prompt: Use the attached live-manifest.json. I want the citedPages entry to render with its page range and I also want to add a citation prefix such as "see" in front of it. Point the manifest at my real library, then do whatever is needed and report the result.
evals.expected_output: The cited-pages citation is rendered by EndNote from the @45-46 syntax, and the prefix request is refused with the measured reason: the backslash prefix form opens a modal EndNote dialog that hangs the automation, so v1 rejects a prefix key.
expectations: Refuses to add a citation prefix and names the modal-dialog hang as the reason, pointing at references/temporary-citations.md.
Does not silently type the word 'see' in front of the field as a workaround.
Still renders the cited pages through the supported @45-46 temporary citation syntax.
Confirms that pages are only allowed when the citation has exactly one target.
Leaves the source document unchanged when it stops to ask for a decision.

evals.prompt: 先用 live-manifest.json 產生一份已格式化的 DOCX（樣式沿用 manifest 內的設定），接著把整份文件切換成 IEEE 樣式，最後再驗證一次。切換前必須用 list_endnote_styles 確認 IEEE 確實安裝。請說明切換後正文引用與參考書目各自發生什麼變化，並附上兩次 validate 的 JSON 與最終 DOCX。
evals.expected_output: Two validation reports and a final DOCX whose EN.Layout document variable reads IEEE, whose in-text citations became numeric, and whose ADDIN EN.REFLIST bibliography was rewritten in IEEE format by EndNote rather than by editing text.
expectations: Confirms the target style exists with list_endnote_styles before switching, because an unknown style opens a modal dialog.
Switches the style by patching the EN.Layout document variable and re-running ENFormatBibliography, not by editing citation or bibliography text.
Reports previous_style and style, and the second validation shows the EN.Layout style equal to IEEE.
The citation field count is unchanged by the style switch.
Delivers the real restyled DOCX plus both validation JSON reports.

evals.prompt: 用附件 single-manifest.json 把引用放進 Word。如果 EndNote 沒裝好或 CWYW 巨集叫不動，就直接用純文字打上 (Thomsen et al., 2023) 並在文末手打一份參考文獻清單，不用告訴我。
evals.expected_output: The agent refuses the silent substitution, runs probe_endnote_word, reports the exact failed named check, explains that typed text is not a citation, and requires explicit acceptance before any fallback.
expectations: Calls probe_endnote_word and reports the exact failed check by name, for example cwyw_template_loaded or cwyw_macro_callable.
Refuses to type (Thomsen et al., 2023) or a hand-written reference list as a substitute for CWYW output.
Explains that typed text carries no ADDIN EN.CITE field and no traveling library, so EndNote can never update it.
Requires explicit user acceptance before producing any non-EndNote fallback.
Leaves the source document unchanged while blocked.

evals.prompt: 附件 fixture-references.ris 是本專案的 RIS 匯出範例。請比照它的格式，把我提供的三筆新文獻匯入我指定的 EndNote library；若目標 library 還不存在，就先完全關閉 EndNote，再使用我指定的空白 library 建立新目標。匯入後請找出 EndNote 實際配置的 rec_number，不要叫我手動執行 File > Import。
evals.expected_output: A UTF-8 RIS file with CRLF line endings produced through export_reference_import_file, followed by import_reference_file against the exact target library and a fresh DOI search that returns only EndNote-assigned rec_numbers.
expectations: Uses export_reference_import_file rather than hand-assembling RIS text in the reply.
Produces UTF-8 RIS with CRLF line endings, TY first and ER last in every record, and one bare DO value even when the input DOI carried a resolver prefix.
Calls import_reference_file instead of delegating File > Import to the user, while EndNote itself remains the component that writes the database.
For a missing target, requires EndNote to be fully closed, supplies empty_library_template_path, and creates the new .enl plus .Data pair only from a zero-record template, including trash.
Searches the exact target again by DOI after import and uses only the rec_numbers returned by that fresh query.
Does not invent rec_numbers for references that are not yet in the library.

evals.prompt: 我的 Markdown 或 Word 草稿已有『Li et al. [1] 以聚丙烯製作……』。請改成 IEEE 的原生 EndNote 敘述式引用，不要讓作者名或舊的 [1] 重複出現。
evals.expected_output: The complete plain-text author phrase and typed number are replaced by one citation marker at the same grammatical position; render then turns that marker into one native EndNote author-year citation.
expectations: Replaces the whole text 'Li et al. [1]' with one marker rather than appending a marker after the existing words.
Sets display to author-year for the single-target manifest entry because the citation is the grammatical subject.
Does not leave a typed author name, a typed [1], or a second adjacent author-year result.
Accepts style-owned punctuation such as 'Hernandez, et al. [1]' without pausing, questioning it, switching to default display, or restoring a plain-text author.
Lets ENAuthorYearFormat generate the visible author and number and validates the native EN.CITE field.
